title: Founding Engineer, Speech Model Training
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company as one of its first engineers, owning the development of speech and audio models from research through production. You will help establish the technical direction and build models that support real-time voice workloads.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Pre-train, post-train, and fine-tune text-to-speech, speech recognition, speech-to-speech models, and specialty classifiers.

 - Turn research ideas into production models for enterprise use cases.

 - Build data, training, and evaluation infrastructure from the ground up.

 - Collaborate with the inference team to optimize models for speed and cost.

 - Help recruit and shape the engineering team as it grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Research background in speech or audio, with published work in the field.

 - A PhD or equivalent academic depth, such as a master's degree with substantial research projects.

 - Full-time industry experience developing speech or audio models after completing your degree.

 - Experience building pre-training or post-training pipelines and machine learning data, training, or evaluation infrastructure.

 - Experience shipping production machine learning models and working across the stack from research to deployment.

 - Ability to fine-tune models for specific use cases and optimize latency and cost in production.

 - Strong technical judgment and comfort working as a generalist in a lean, early-stage environment.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually, depending on experience. Equity: 0.5% to 1.5%. Visa sponsorship is available depending on visa type, including J-1 and O-1.


LOCATION

Fully remote. Candidates may be based in Canada, Brazil, Europe, or the United States.

title: Founding Engineer, Inference
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Own the low-level inference stack for real-time speech models at an early-stage AI company. As one of the first engineers, you will shape technical direction, engineering culture, and the team's growth.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and optimize production runtimes for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, speech-to-speech, and specialized models.

 - Improve latency and cost through GPU kernels, batching, scheduling, quantization, speculative decoding, and hardware-aware optimization.

 - Design reliable serving infrastructure that meets real-time requirements for enterprise voice workloads.

 - Work with model training teams to ensure new models are designed for fast inference.

 - Help hire and shape the engineering team as it grows.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Industry experience after completing a degree, with strong experience in ML inference or systems; this role is not intended for new graduates.

 - Experience building or optimizing production runtimes that serve machine learning models.

 - Skills in GPU programming, kernel optimization, model serving, compilers, or performance engineering.

 - Experience optimizing production systems for latency and cost, and building infrastructure for reliability and real-time requirements.

 - Research depth through a PhD, research-focused master's degree, or substantial research projects, ideally in speech, audio, or a related field.

 - Comfort working across technical domains in a small, fast-moving team; experience with speech models and techniques such as batching, scheduling, quantization, or speculative decoding is valuable.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary: $200,000 to $350,000 annually, depending on experience. Equity: 0.5% to 1.5%. Visa sponsorship is available depending on visa type, including J-1 and O-1.


LOCATION

Fully remote. Candidates may be based in Canada, Brazil, Europe, or the United States.
